text:
jonathan: Quick ping — PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-client/pull/2142. Adds tool-call passthrough to the Python REST client and a small semver tweak to /v1/chat. Need a reviewer for approval; low-risk but touches retry behaviour. PTAL when you have a sec.

kevin: On it. What's the impact on existing pinning? Any behavioral change for timeouts or retries?

jonathan: No breaking surface change for callers — we introduce an optional `tool_context` kwarg (not required). We did adjust the streaming fallback retry window from `1s` -> `500ms` to shave tail latency; details are in the PR description under "Motivation & Compatibility".

amira: Left 3 inline comments about docstrings and a type-hint. Also can you add a small unit test asserting `tool_context` serializes as `tool_context` (not `tools`)? That one bit caused a bug in the node client last month.

sarah: CI is a bit flaky on macos-latest today; not blocking but tagging @ci-bot for visibility so we can rerun if needed.

ci-bot: status: checks/push — python-tests ✅, lint ✅, macos-latest flaky test previously failed but branch now shows green. If you push new commits I can re-run checks automatically. Use `/retest` in the PR if you want a manual rerun.

kevin: Thanks @amira. I'll focus on the retry default change — main worry is callers that relied on the old fallback window for long-polling flows. If it's purely for streaming fallback path it's probably fine, but please document the rationale in the PR summary.

jonathan: Good call. Added a short rationale section and linked a microbenchmark showing ~12% latency reduction on short sequences. I'll add the unit test and doc tweaks in a follow-up commit in the same PR and push within the next hour.

amira: Conditional approve from me once the test is present. Please add a single-line TODO in the PR body referencing the expected test name and I will flip to approve. :thumbsup:

kevin: Conditional approve from me as well, assuming CI stays green after your test. We should also backport to `dedicated-1.x` — not urgent but good to keep parity. @sarah can you handle that after merge?

sarah: Yep I can cut the backport. Prefer to do the backport after EOD to avoid mid-day deploy churn.

jonathan: Thanks team — pushing the doc + unit test now.

jonathan: (30m later) pushed commit `add-tool-context-test docfix` and requested re-review. CI is running.

ci-bot: status: checks/push — all checks passed (python-tests, lint, integration). macos-latest stable this run.

kevin: CI green, I'm merging this once Amira gives the final ok.

amira: Verified the test and docs, approving now. Go ahead and merge after kevin.

jonathan: Merged. Thanks everyone — will file the backport ticket for `dedicated-1.x` and ping @sarah with PR details.

sarah: Got it, will handle backport later today.
